resolved_preparation_defects.defect: Proposed T13-local GitHub Actions workflow contained an invalid YAML heredoc indentation boundary.
resolved_preparation_defects.evidence: GitHub Actions run 35709301617 completed failure with zero jobs, then local syntax diagnosis identified the unindented embedded Python block.
resolved_preparation_defects.root_cause: A shell heredoc body escaped the YAML run-block indentation.
resolved_preparation_defects.repair: Replaced the heredoc, then removed the entire T13-local workflow when canonical governance ownership review showed it was unnecessary.

resolved_preparation_defects.defect: Initial candidate attempted to add T13-local tool/workflow paths that were not authorized by base governance ownership.
resolved_preparation_defects.evidence: Production governance run 35709460648 rejected .github/workflows/havenline-task13-preactivation.yml and tools/havenline/task13/* while accepting all eight Docs/Production/T13 files.
resolved_preparation_defects.root_cause: The candidate tried to self-authorize new governance surfaces instead of reusing already-integrated canonical production controls.
resolved_preparation_defects.repair: Removed all three self-authored governance files and narrowed planned T13 ownership to exactly five shipping/test files plus Docs/Production/T13/**.

resolved_preparation_defects.evidence: Internal cross-check against authoritative Docs/Production/CRITIC_MATRIX.json showed C6 is Performance Critic and C7 is Progression / Difficulty Critic for T13.
resolved_preparation_defects.root_cause: Task-local prose drifted from the canonical critic taxonomy while preserving only the ID list.
resolved_preparation_defects.repair: Rewrote the T13 critic acceptance matrix to match canonical C2/C3/C4/C6/C7 names/responsibilities and kept spend-blind/GM isolation as mandatory evidence without repurposing critic IDs.

resolved_build_defects.defect: C2 exact-candidate visual review launched a fresh Godot checkout without importing the project first, so class-name cache resolution failed in unrelated main-scene scripts and the render timed out.
resolved_build_defects.evidence: Run 35717659264 review-c2: HavenlineStationKit/HavenlineHarvestPresentation parse errors followed by exit 124; the built-pending-dependency job on the same candidate passed project import and both T13 suites.
resolved_build_defects.root_cause: C2 job-local evidence harness omitted the Godot import step even though each GitHub Actions job has an isolated workspace.
resolved_build_defects.repair: Import the exact candidate in the C2 job before launching existing render-review scenarios; retain visual non-impact proof and independent C2 review.

resolved_build_defects.defect: C4 evidence exposed only backend reason codes/coefficients, allowing the reviewer to infer that difficulty changes had no stable downstream danger/recovery/world-response/next-action presentation contract; it also misread task_approved=false as a test failure rather than the intentional T12 lifecycle lock.
resolved_build_defects.evidence: Run 35717659264 review-c4 scored world_change_clarity 3.0 and multiple clarity dimensions 4-5, citing missing feedback and task_approved=false.
resolved_build_defects.root_cause: T13 had deterministic challenge semantics but no explicit cross-owner readability handoff, and critic evidence did not separate implementation validation from dependency-gated task approval.
resolved_build_defects.repair: Add deterministic t13.readability.v1 output, test all C4 ownership boundaries, emit source-bound readability evidence, and state lifecycle lock separately from implementation validation.

resolved_build_defects.defect: The new 100-level readability integration assertion used inferred typing for a Dictionary value returned through Variant access, which Godot 4.7.2 refused to infer.
resolved_build_defects.evidence: Run 35730422938: core T13 suite passed all 57 checks; test_task13_integration.gd then failed parse with 'Cannot infer the type of readable variable because the value does not have a set type.'
resolved_build_defects.root_cause: Test-only GDScript local variable relied on inference across a dynamic Dictionary property.
resolved_build_defects.repair: Declare readable explicitly as Dictionary; no runtime Challenge Director behavior changed.

resolved_build_defects.defect: C2 completed all six exact-candidate renders but the generic ERROR grep treated two known pre-existing baked-media warnings as T13 regressions.
resolved_build_defects.evidence: Run 35730558553 review-c2 showed only the known missing baked outpost audio and missing baked crew motion ERROR lines before the blanket grep exited 1.
resolved_build_defects.root_cause: C2 did not classify known upstream evidence-fixture warnings separately from new render failures.
resolved_build_defects.repair: Allowlist only those two exact warning messages, require both to be observed, keep all other ERROR/SCRIPT ERROR/Parse Error/ObjectDB leak signals fatal, and include the allowlist proof in C2 evidence.

resolved_build_defects.defect: The exact-warning classifier was placed after six render commands under set -euo pipefail; the final Godot capture returned exit 1 because of the known baked-media warnings, aborting before classification could execute.
resolved_build_defects.evidence: Run 35732467356 review-c2 reached all six renders; the final shelter-detail log contained only the two known baked-media warning families, then the shell exited 1 before the post-render classifier or manifest step.
resolved_build_defects.root_cause: C2 capture control flow treated the raw Godot process code as authoritative before evaluating the bounded warning policy and required evidence artifacts.
resolved_build_defects.repair: Record each capture process exit without immediate pipefail termination, allow only exit 0/1, then require exact warning classification plus native-scene.png and render-evidence.json for every capture; any unexpected ERROR/parse/script/leak signal remains fatal.
